name: Wingman/Corvus
description: A hierarchical, pattern-matched event bus for the Wingman framework. Routes signals across a dot-namespaced tree with single- and multi-level wildcard support, dispatching to listeners in priority order via a composable middleware pipeline. Features predicate-filtered emission, target-scoped listeners, match-all and historical-replay subscription modes, deferred emission queues with tagging and selective flushing, named-bus registry, cross-bus forwarding, circular-emission guards, and a comprehensive typed exception hierarchy.
